title: briefcase 1:1 play notes - product <> eng lead
content:
Context:
Quick prep for weekly 1:1 with Eng Lead (Arjun). Focus: unblock Dedicated capacity rollout, console UX fix for token billing, and private deployment checklist items we promised to SOC/compliance customer. This is a scratchpad — mix of bullets, tickets, and action owners.

Top goals for this week:
- Unstick Dedicated pre-provisioning on eu-west-2 (we have a customer pilot needing capacity on 09/20).
- Decide console billing display: per-route vs consolidated tokens (affects docs + pricing page).
- Verify Private install checklist completes security review (KMS keys + audit logs).

Standing 1:1 agenda (2x items timeboxed):
1) 10m: status + blockers (routing + infra)
2) 10m: product asks (console UX, docs)
3) 10m: operational items (oncall burdens, rollout timeline)
4) 10m: career/people check-in (skip if short)

Quick notes to bring up / prompts:
- Dedicated: infra reported sporadic provisioning failures when target pool is at 85% GPU utilization. hypothesis: scheduler backpressure + retry storm. Ask SRE for a temporary rate limiter and a graceful fallback (queue + notify). Link to incident draft in Linear (RED-467).
- Console billing: customers ask for both per-route breakdown and a single invoice line. Tradeoffs: UI complexity v. support cost. Propose default consolidated with expandable per-route view. Need Arjun's estimate (frontend + backend effort).
- Private: compliance reviewer flagged KMS rotation docs missing for on-prem installer. Quick win: add a step in the installer wizard + include KMS rotation playbook in the private deployment repo. Who owns docs? Lina said she'll take first pass.

Unresolved questions (to land in meeting):
- Can we ship a conservative UI change (collapsible token breakdown) without backend schema changes this sprint?
- If Dedicated pool provisioning fails for pilot, fallback plan: temporarily re-route traffic to hosted API (with cost offsets). Is that OK for pilot contract? (CS signoff?)
- What telemetry will SRE surface to us to say provisioning is healthy? Define 3 signals.

Scratch discussion points (notes during meeting):
- Arjun: "scheduler miscounts queued jobs when KV cache is warm" — action: add guarded metric for queue depth post-kv-warm.
- I: note to self: confirm pilot contract permits hosted fallback until Dedicated is stable (ask Alex in CS).
- Arjun: estimates 2 dev-weeks for front + 1 dev-week backend to implement expandable view, can be dropped to 1+0 if we do client-side toggle only.

Decisions needed by EOD Friday:
- Approve console UX approach: consolidated default + expandable breakdown (yes/no).
- Confirm fallback plan for pilot (hosted API warm path).

Action items (things to follow up after meeting):
- Arjun: prototype expandable token UI stub (frontend) — due 2024-09-17.
- Lina: draft KMS rotation appendix for private installer repo and link in self-service checklist — due 2024-09-12.
- Celine (me): check pilot contract + loop in Alex (CS) to confirm hosted fallback is permissible — due 2024-09-06.
- SRE (assign SRE on RED-467): add rate limiter + alert playbook for Dedicated provisioning; surface 3 health signals (queue depth, GPU saturation, provisioning latency) — due 2024-09-13.
- Docs: add short help text in Console explaining token consolidation and how to view per-route details — owner TBD (ask docs squad) — due 2024-09-20.

Parking lot / nice-to-have (not blocking):
- Metrics dashboard widget for per-customer per-route cost heatmap.
- Automated KMS rotation via operator for on-prem (longer term).

Prep checklist for the meeting (what I need to have):
- Brief prototype screenshot (Arjun can sketch) or link to quick figma.
- One-paragraph fallback plan to read on call (Celine drafts).
- Linear ticket numbers and brief status for RED-452, RED-467, RED-499.

Post-meeting follow-ups (short log):
- Capture decisions in RED-452 PRD comment.
- Update console rollout page with agreed timeline.
- Schedule 30m follow-up with SRE next Tuesday to review telemetry.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep the tone in the 1:1 collaborative — frame tradeoffs, not prescriptive mandates.
- If Arjun pushes for delaying UI change, be ready to trade scope for phased rollout (mobile + desktop later).
- Remember to surface customer impact (pilot customer name redacted in notes) — keeps priority clear.

End of scratchpad.
